bio: David Wilson Jolly (born October 31, 1972) is an American lawyer and politician who was the Democratic nominee for the 2026 Florida gubernatorial election. Jolly served as the U.S. representative for Florida's 13th congressional district from 2014 to 2017 as a Republican. After leaving office, he became a prominent critic of President Donald Trump and a political commentator for national cable news outlets.
